classification.difficultyReason: Calculate average speed, convert both units of a speed and apply an exchange rate in both directions.

children.label: a
children.prompt: A truck has driven the 1050 km from Adelaide to Innamincka in $13\frac{1}{2}$ hours. What was its average speed, in kilometres per hour? Give your answer correct to the nearest kilometre per hour.

answer.worked:
In $13\frac{1}{2}$ hours, the truck travels 1050 km. Find the distance travelled per hour.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Average speed}&=1050\div\frac{27}{2}\\\text{Average speed}&=\frac{700}{9}\text{ km/h}\\\text{Average speed}&\approx78\text{ km/h}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: A bullet is fired at a speed of 800 metres per second. What is its speed in kilometres per hour?

answer.worked:
Convert seconds to minutes, minutes to hours, then metres to kilometres.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Speed}&=800\text{ m/s}\\\text{Speed}&=800\times60\text{ m/min}\\\text{Speed}&=48\,000\times60\text{ m/h}\\\text{Speed}&=2\,880\,000\div1000\text{ km/h}\\\text{Speed}&=2880\text{ km/h}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: At a certain time, one Australian dollar bought 72 US cents.

children.label: i
children.prompt: Express $\text{A}\$21.06$ in US dollars, correct to the nearest US cent.

answer.worked:
$\text{A}\$1$ buys $\text{US}\$0.72$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{US dollar amount}&=21.06\times0.72\\\text{US dollar amount}&=15.1632\\\text{US dollar amount}&\approx15.16.\end{align*}$$

Therefore, $\text{A}\$21.06$ buys $\text{US}\$15.16$, to the nearest US cent.

children.label: ii
children.prompt: Express $\text{US}\$21$ in Australian dollars, correct to the nearest Australian cent.

answer.worked:
$\text{US}\$0.72$ is worth $\text{A}\$1$, so $\text{US}\$1$ is worth $\text{A}\$\frac{1}{0.72}$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Australian dollar amount}&=21\div0.72\\\text{Australian dollar amount}&=\frac{175}{6}\\\text{Australian dollar amount}&\approx29.17.\end{align*}$$

Therefore, $\text{US}\$21$ is worth $\text{A}\$29.17$, to the nearest Australian cent.
